description:
## Functional specifications covered with associated files to edit/add
Extend Resources.Registry, QueryResources schema and Query, tool catalog, and owning Agent guide. Expose label definitions and document metadata; document filters label_ids plus label_match any/all. Preserve existing resources and permission filtering before count/page. Label discovery access policy awaiting user answer.
## Tests to add before implementation
Validated Jido execution for new types; descriptions and field allowlists; document grants including person/team/Everyone/update-only; any/all, duplicates, unknown IDs, removed assignments, invalid filters, stable pagination and ID behavior; property tests for matching invariants.
## Branches/paths validated
Absent filters preserve existing listing; default match any; empty list matches no documents; nonempty positive integer IDs capped at 100; unknown IDs never broaden results; selected assignments only. Raw content, metadata and operational internals excluded from document outputs.
## Mocking plan
Real Repo sandbox, real permissions and Jido.Exec. No production dependency mocking.
## Documentations to update for both code and docs/ related content
Agent service guide owns resources.query extension contract. Module docs and registry/tool descriptions updated. Beadwork owns progress.
## Action reuse assessment
Extend existing QueryResources workflow Action: it already owns resource discovery, read filtering, field validation, serialization, count, sort and pagination. Provider List/SearchDocuments operate on external providers and cannot query local category assignments. Registry is allowlist owner; Query is read orchestrator; Ingestion owns category rows/assignments. New query helper only if needed for cohesive relationship validation, never a duplicate Action. No mutations, new tool key or new global state.
## Context and invariants
Flow: validated Action -> allowlisted descriptor -> read-authorized Ecto query -> filters -> count/page -> serialization. DB owns records and grants; execution context owns trusted identity/bypass. Resource filter values currently assume schema fields; virtual label filters require explicit validation and query handling. Existing get ignores search/filters; new document label filters must not silently bypass on get. Existing describe test exact type list needs approved update; user approved it in this conversation. Existing direct read-grant query includes Everyone and is reusable for documents. No broad refactor.

comments.text: Context analysis complete. Public Query entrypoint has trusted person/team identity and explicit bypass; query serialization is allowlisted. Private document grants use resource_permissions read rights including Everyone, matching current label resource checks. Label records have no independent ACL, so user explicitly chose visibility via selected assignments on readable documents, with trusted context bypass. Existing exact describe-type assertion update approved. Implementing now; DB writes/global state out of scope.

Implemented label/document descriptors, schema and tool catalog entries. Label discovery inherits selected document assignments and existing read-authorized query; explicit trusted context bypass sees all. DocumentFilters validates up to 100 positive bigint IDs and any/all, deduplicates, matches selected document-only assignments via subquery, and keeps empty IDs fail-closed. Documents support filtered get/search, metadata-only projection and stable ID tie-breaker. Existing resources unchanged. User-approved exact allowlist expectation updated in Action describe and Registry tests. Added real validated Jido execution, ACL/person/team/Everyone/update-only, get filters, field restrictions, paging, malformed IDs and matching property coverage. Agent guide documents contracts. Self-review found no additional correctness issues. mix q completed (existing LabelEditor disabled-attribute warning remains); targeted suite 130 passed (3 properties, 127 tests). Full PR review/coverage/precommit remains tracked by zaq-kw0.19; no commit or push.
